text:
alyssa: Heads up — Tenant Zeta is hitting repeated inference timeouts on our Dedicated eu-west-2 pool. Time window 2026-02-17 23:12–23:45 UTC. Sample request ids: r-9c4f1a2b, r-9c4f1a2c. Need repro bundle: pod logs, node dmesg, nvidia-smi snapshots, kernel XID traces, and a curl repro. Can infra grab this? :eyes:

mike: Can you drop the exact pod/namespace and any example request payloads or headers we should attach? Also which nodes to target?

alyssa: Namespace is `tenant-zeta`. Pod label is `app=inference` (container `worker`). Example curl (include `x-request-id` header):

```bash
curl -v 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' -H 'x-request-id: r-9c4f1a2b' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"vicuna-13b","input":"short ping"}'
```

Also try this quick kubectl to capture logs (40m window):

```bash
kubectl -n tenant-zeta logs -l app=inference -c worker --since=40m > tenant-zeta-pods.log
kubectl -n tenant-zeta get pods -o wide > tenant-zeta-pod-list.txt
kubectl -n tenant-zeta describe pod $(kubectl -n tenant-zeta get pods -l app=inference -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') > pod-describe.txt
```

mike: Got it. Which node hostnames?

alyssa: Nodes observed in the tracer: `gpu-eu2-n1`, `gpu-eu2-n3` (both in eu-west-2). Time-aligned with request ids above.

juan: I'll pull node-level stuff. Commands I'll run (posting for visibility):

```bash
ssh ubuntu@gpu-eu2-n1 'sudo dmesg -T | tail -n 500' > gpu-eu2-n1-dmesg.txt
sudo journalctl -u kubelet -o short-iso --since "2026-02-17 23:00:00" > kubelet.log
sudo journalctl -u containerd --since "2026-02-17 23:00:00" > containerd.log
# GPU snapshot (60s sample)
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=timestamp,index,name,utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,memory.total,memory.used --format=csv -lms 1000 -f nvsnap.csv & sleep 60; kill $!
# Check for kernel XID errors
grep -i 'NVRM: Xid' /var/log/kern.log || true
```

support-aly: Please include the tenant request ids and the curl reproduction above in the bundle metadata. I'll attach to ticket #12345 and request priority parsing. Also prefer tarball upload to our S3 path: `s3://redwood-support/tenant-zeta/1745678901/` with a README that lists the timeframe and request ids. :white_check_mark:

dev-bot: Reminder: use the support bundle checklist: `kubectl logs`, `kubectl describe`, `node dmesg`, `kubelet/containerd logs`, `nvidia-smi csv`, `k8s events`, and include the reproduction curl + headers.

juan: Uploading bundle now. ETA ~20m. Will include presigned URL when done.

infra-bot: Bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-support/tenant-zeta/1745678901/dedicated-repro-bundle-1745678901.tar.gz (presigned link valid 72h). Attached files: tenant-zeta-pods.log, pod-describe.txt, gpu-eu2-n1-dmesg.txt, kubelet.log, containerd.log, nvsnap.csv, kernel-xid-grep.txt, reproduce-curl.txt.

mike: Thanks — I'll start the offline trace analysis and check KV-cache timings around the request ids. If we need a live repro, I'll ask Alyssa to coordinate a short traffic window.

alyssa: Thanks team. If anyone sees repeated `Xid` or `GPU Reset` lines in dmesg, flag immediately here and we can open infra escalation.

support-aly: Attached to ticket and notified customer of collection in progress. Will update once analysis completes. :handshake:
